dedupe_keys.name: dri connect cdri knowledge platform on disaster resilient infrastructure

description: DRI Connect is the knowledge platform of the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure, gathering publications, the G20-India disaster resilient infrastructure compendium, case studies, white papers, journal material, videos, webinars, e-learning and communities of practice. Pages read list working papers on financing resilient transport, a Learning from Disaster dialogue series on events such as the Venezuela doublet earthquake, webinars on Papua New Guinea transport and a Dominican Republic early warning system, and communities of practice on seaport resilience indicators and resilient housing. CDRI and its member countries and partners supply the content, and it links to the Global Infrastructure Resilience Reports. Coverage is global, with CDRI member countries prominent. Format and access: a web portal; listings are open and some features need a free account. Licence: not stated on the page read; free. Caveats: it is a curated library of documents and events, not a dataset, and item quality varies. It helps find case material and guidance for resilience and adaptation studies of infrastructure. Related catalogue records are the CDRI Global Infrastructure Resilience Report 2025 and the GIRI data platform.
